description: This file is a C header file defining interfaces for component management in a software project, including function declarations for setting and getting component parameters, adding/removing instances, and handling CSV string parameters.

methods.name: component_set_bool
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter for a specified component.

methods.name: component_set_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific component.

methods.name: component_set_str_param
methods.description: Sets a string parameter for a specified component.

methods.name: component_set_params
methods.description: Sets multiple parameters for a component using an array of amxc_var_t.

methods.name: component_get_path_instance
methods.description: Retrieves the instance path of a component based on a query.

methods.name: component_add_instance
methods.description: Adds a new component instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: component_del_instance
methods.description: Deletes a component instance based on its object path.

methods.name: component_get_param
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value from a component.

methods.name: component_add_string_to_csv
methods.description: Adds a string value to a CSV parameter in a component.

methods.name: component_remove_string_from_csv
methods.description: Removes a string value from a CSV parameter in a component.
